summary: Full stack testing of OFM Dashboard. All 14 backend API tests pass. All 5 frontend pages load correctly with full CRUD functionality working.

minor.issue: When ENCRYPTION_KEY is empty, cookie/xbc/anthropic_key values are silently discarded (encrypt_val returns None). has_cookie, has_xbc, has_anthropic_key return false even when values were provided. This is by design but user should see a clear warning that ENCRYPTION_KEY must be set.

integration_issues.issue: Start Bot button calls the API correctly but bot stays 'Stopped' because node main.js does not exist at /app/main.js. This is an environment/deployment issue, not a UI bug.

issues: Cookie badge shows 'missing' in red whenever ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured, which is always in this environment. Consider showing a global warning about missing ENCRYPTION_KEY instead of per-account badge.

action_items: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY in backend/.env (64-char hex) to enable cookie/credential storage
Ensure node main.js exists at BOT_DIR for bot start/stop to work
Consider adding a global warning banner in UI when ENCRYPTION_KEY is not configured
critical_code_review_comments: ENCRYPTION_KEY is empty in .env - all tenant credentials (cookie, x-bc, anthropic key) are silently dropped on save. This is the main blocker for functional use.
Bot start calls `node main.js` at BOT_DIR=/app but no main.js exists - bot will always fail to start silently.
approve_draft uses sync httpx.post (hx.post) instead of async - this will block the event loop. Should use async httpx client.
server.py is 642 lines - acceptable but could be split into routers for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: No seed data left; test tenant TEST_Creator was created and deleted during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API fully tested, all CRUD flows work. UI flows work. Core blocker is ENCRYPTION_KEY not set (credentials not persisted) and no node main.js (bot cannot start). SSE logs stream is connected (Live badge shown). Chats page shows account selector. No auth needed.

rca_of_issues.cookie_not_stored: encrypt_val() returns None when ENCRYPTION_KEY env var is empty string. The INSERT stores empty string ''. safe_tenant() then sees empty string as falsy -> has_cookie=False. Fix: set a valid 32-byte hex ENCRYPTION_KEY in backend/.env
rca_of_issues.bot_start_fails: subprocess.Popen(['node', 'main.js'], cwd='/app') fails because /app/main.js does not exist. Bot reports 'started' with a PID but process immediately exits. Fix: ensure the Node.js bot script exists at BOT_DIR or update BOT_DIR.
